mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates by reducing risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger recessionary expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate revenue visibility and inventory adjustments.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 230.0 (1982-1984=100) indicates persistent high inflation that forces aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through rising real interest rates and equity valuation compression.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 230.0.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.0 (2017=100) signals manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate capacity utilization and earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through recessionary risk premiums.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 800.0 thousand units signals robust residential construction and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through increased consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 800.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent CPI index above 230.0 and federal funds rate above 0.5% indicate active monetary tightening amid high inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated real interest rates and reduced equity risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 230.0 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Nonfarm payrolls below 130,000 thousand persons signal weakening labor market momentum that reduces consumer spending and corporate hiring, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings downgrades.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS < 130000.0.
